name: ascent
description: 崗起 / Ascent — 規則驅動生產的無限發展模擬經營

scripts.setup:db: pnpm setup:env && pnpm --filter @ascent/shared build && pnpm --filter @ascent/api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @ascent/api exec -- prisma db push && pnpm db:seed
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ascent/shared build && pnpm --filter @ascent/api exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @ascent/web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ascent/shared build && pnpm --filter @ascent/shared test && pnpm --filter @ascent/api test
